summary: Frontend-only test of the rewritten /xo-vision-care-system page (System.jsx). Verified at 1920px, 2560px and 390px: page loads with 0 console errors and 0 failed network requests / broken images. All 9 sidebar anchors render in the correct numbered order (01 What it is ... 09 See it work) with correct data-testids, and clicking each smoothly scrolls the matching section to y~228. All 4 workflow step big numerals are synced to page-wide numbering (Schedule 03, Exam 04, Fit 05, Finish 06). All 4 'In detail' links have the correct hrefs and navigating (schedule -> /xoiris-scheduling) plus browser back works. All new copy blocks verified present: two-line 01 headline, 4-row component list (xoIris/xoExam/xoFit/xoLab), bordered pull-quote, 6-tile 'What it delivers' grid (SYSTEM_OUTCOMES body copy), 8 outcome tag pills from the untouched SIX_OUTCOMES, 7-row comparison table, new replaces intro paragraph, new Deployment headline + intro + 4 numbered scenarios + closing paragraph, and the new DemoCTA headline/body with working /request-a-demo link. Hero contains 0 links/buttons as required. No em/en dashes in page copy (only the pre-existing footer copyright). Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow, sidebar hidden, all 7 'XO:' mobile labels render inline, footer + CTA intact. Dark/light theme toggle works (dark body bg rgb(6,16,36) navy, not black). Two design-rule deviations found (rounded table wrapper, sidebar overlapping section 07 headline).

ui_bugs.component: System.jsx - '07 What it replaces' comparison table wrapper
ui_bugs.issue: Violates the 'no rounded-box card wrappers' design rule: the table container still has `rounded-md` (computed border-radius 4.4px). A DOM audit of #whatitis, #outcomes, #replaces, #deployment found this as the ONLY rounded element (outcome tag pills excluded as intentional). Fix: drop `rounded-md` from the wrapper at System.jsx line ~391.

issues: Fixed SectionAnchors sidebar overlays the '07 What it replaces' headline. Because the nav now has 9 items (~330px tall vs 5 items / ~180px on Home.jsx) and sections 07/08/09 are full-width `xo-container` blocks whose text starts at the container's left edge, the nav's blurred gradient panel sits directly on top of the eyebrow + 'Fewer instruments. Fewer vendors.' line after clicking anchor 07 (see screenshot). Headline is unreadable while the nav is pinned. Same collision risk for 08 Deployment. Suggested fix: left-pad / grid-offset the full-width sections' content on lg+, or cap nav height / offset the scroll target.

At 2560px, 'Fewer instruments. Fewer vendors.' stays on 1 line but 'Fewer places for the day to slow down.' wraps to 2 lines ('Fewer places for the / day to slow down.') because both MaskTextInView spans are capped at max-w-4xl (896px). No stray word merges across the two sentences, but the pair reads unbalanced on wide screens. Suggest max-w-5xl or text-wrap:balance for these two headline lines.
Footer copyright renders an en dash: '© 2022–2026 XENON OPHTHALMICS INC.' This is in the shared Footer (pre-existing, not part of this rewrite) but contradicts the site-wide no en/em dash copy rule.

action_items: Remove `rounded-md` from the '07 What it replaces' table wrapper in System.jsx (only remaining rounded box on the page).
Fix the fixed sidebar nav overlapping the '07 What it replaces' headline at lg+ (9-item nav is taller than the Home.jsx 5-item nav it was designed against).
Optional: widen/balance the two 'Fewer ...' headline lines so the second does not wrap at 2560px.
Optional: replace the en dash in the Footer copyright year range with a hyphen to honour the no-dash copy rule.
critical_code_review_comments: System.jsx is 474 lines with all copy inline; acceptable, but consider moving the SYSTEM_OUTCOMES / REPLACES / DEPLOYMENT_SCENARIOS data into a page-local data module if it grows further.

STEPS[].n is a hardcoded string ('03'..'06') that must be manually kept in sync with the ANCHORS array order; deriving it from ANCHORS.findIndex(a => a.id === step.id) + 1 would make the numbering self-healing and prevent the exact mismatch that was just fixed.
SIX_OUTCOMES.find((s) => s.key === key) is dereferenced as o.title without a guard; a typo in STEPS[].outcomes would throw a runtime TypeError and blank the page. Add optional chaining or a fallback.

Most new content elements lack data-testid (section eyebrows, component rows, outcome tiles, replaces rows, deployment scenario rows, big step numerals). Only outcome tags and 'In detail' links are instrumented, which forced DOM/structural selectors in this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: System.jsx rewrite is functionally correct: anchors, numbering (03-06 synced), In detail links, all copy blocks, mobile 390 and dark mode all pass with zero console errors. Note the SectionAnchors nav is `visibility:hidden` until the scroll position enters the tracked range, so Playwright must scroll into #whatitis before clicking any [data-testid=anchor-*]. Open items are cosmetic: rounded-md on the #replaces table, sidebar overlaying the #replaces headline at lg+, second 'Fewer ...' headline wrapping at 2560px, footer en dash.
rca_of_the_issue: Sidebar overlap RCA: SectionAnchors renders position:fixed at top:128px over the measured grid-column left/width. Sections 07-09 in System.jsx are full-width siblings using xo-container (so backgrounds bleed edge to edge), so their text column starts at the same left offset the nav occupies. With 9 nav items the nav is ~330px tall and its bottom now falls inside the eyebrow/headline band of the section scrolled to (scrollTo offset -100), unlike Home.jsx where 5 items clear the headline.
